subject.title: Feature: Add maxSubagentResultChars to truncate subagent results injected into parent session

question: Should OpenClaw bound subagent completion payloads with a fixed internal cap, an existing agent context-limit setting, the proposed new `session.maxSubagentResultChars` key, or the broader metadata-only completion contract?
rationale: The missing cap is source-proven, but the requested fix changes parent-agent review semantics and may add public configuration surface, which repository policy treats as a maintainer product/API decision.

options.title: Bound without a new session key
options.body: Apply a task-completion handoff cap across core subagents and harness completions, using an existing context-limit surface or a fixed internal default instead of adding `session.*` config.

options.title: Add the requested config key
options.body: Expose `session.maxSubagentResultChars` and update schema, docs, tests, and any doctor/config expectations for the new public setting.

options.title: Defer to metadata-only completion
options.body: Keep this narrow issue open only as part of the broader status-and-session-link contract tracked in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/96975.

recommendation.title: Bound without a new session key
recommendation.body: Apply a task-completion handoff cap across core subagents and harness completions, using an existing context-limit surface or a fixed internal default instead of adding `session.*` config.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the clearest feature-history signal on the structured internal completion event boundary and adjacent queue steering path.
